ENGLISH_SOURCE:
[1] q: Does PCA collect my child's data?
[1] a: PCA needs to process some information to provide protection. The design goal is to keep sensitive activity on trusted family-side devices or synchronize it end-to-end encrypted where required, instead of creating a readable central PCA profile. Central services still need minimum account and technical data to operate.
[2] q: How do I report a privacy or security concern?
[2] a: If you believe you have found a security issue, please hold it until PCA publishes its reporting channels — see Contact. Do not include child-sensitive content unless the support team explicitly and safely requests specific information.

[1] body: Use the minimum information needed for useful protection.
[2] title: Privacy by design

[3] title: Transparency
[3] body: Parents should understand what a feature does and what information it needs.
[4] title: Child dignity
[4] body: Protection should not humiliate children or treat them as suspects.
[5] title: Age-appropriate protection
[5] body: Different ages and family situations need different boundaries.
[6] title: Parent responsibility
[6] body: PCA supports parents; it does not replace communication, judgment or care.
[7] title: No hidden monitoring
[7] body: PCA should not depend on covert message capture, password capture, hidden screen recording or background gallery collection.
[8] title: Accessible safety
[8] body: Meaningful protection should be designed for broad family access.
[9] title: No false capability claims
[9] body: Trust requires honesty about what is available, limited or coming later.

ENGLISH_SOURCE:
[1] title: Photos, videos and files
[1] body: PCA does not need routine access to a child's photo library, videos or arbitrary files. These must not be collected into a readable central PCA database.
[2] title: Messages
[2] body: No routine PCA protection feature is designed to capture or centrally read personal messages.
[3] title: App use and screen time
[3] body: Readable app-usage history must not become centrally readable PCA data. App use may be processed locally where needed for protection.
[4] title: Browsing protection
[4] body: PCA's privacy rule is that readable browsing history must not be stored centrally. Web-safety functions may still need local processing to make protection decisions.
[5] title: Location
[5] body: Location is sensitive. Any approved location feature must be parent-controlled and designed so readable precise-location history does not become central PCA data.
[6] title: Camera and eye distance
[6] body: Eye-distance protection using the camera is planned for a later release. It is not an active feature today, and how any future version would handle camera frames will be described here once it has been verified.

[1] title: الصور والفيديوهات والملفات
[1] body: لا تحتاج الحماية المعتادة إلى الوصول إلى مكتبة صور الطفل أو فيديوهاته أو ملفاته العشوائية، ويجب ألا تُجمع هذه الأشياء في قاعدة بيانات مركزية مقروءة لدى PCA.
[2] title: الرسائل
[2] body: لم تُصمم وظائف الحماية المعتادة في PCA لالتقاط الرسائل الشخصية أو قراءتها مركزيًا.
[3] title: استخدام التطبيقات ووقت الشاشة
[3] body: يجب ألا يتحول سجل استخدام التطبيقات المقروء إلى بيانات مركزية لدى PCA. يمكن معالجة استخدام التطبيقات محليًا عندما تحتاج وظيفة الحماية إلى ذلك.
[4] title: الحماية أثناء التصفح
[4] body: قاعدة الخصوصية في PCA هي عدم حفظ سجل التصفح المقروء مركزيًا. وقد تحتاج الحماية على الويب إلى معالجة محلية لاتخاذ قرار الحماية.
[5] title: الموقع
[5] body: الموقع معلومات حساسة. يجب أن تكون أي ميزة موقع معتمدة تحت تحكم الوالدين، وألا يتحول سجل الموقع الدقيق المقروء إلى بيانات مركزية لدى PCA.
[6] title: الكاميرا والمسافة عن الشاشة
[6] body: حماية المسافة بين العين والشاشة عبر الكاميرا مخطط لها في إصدار لاحق. وهي ليست ميزة فعّالة اليوم، وسنوضح هنا كيفية تعامل أي إصدار مستقبلي مع صور الكاميرا بعد التحقق من ذلك.

[1] title: What PCA processes locally
[1] body: Some protection functions need information on the child device. PCA's approach is to process that information locally wherever possible.
[2] title: What may synchronize between trusted family devices
[2] body: When sensitive protection information needs to move between trusted parent and child endpoints, PCA is designed to use end-to-end encrypted delivery where required. Production scope remains subject to security verification.
[3] title: What PCA central services need
[3] body: Central services may keep minimum technical records for parent accounts/authentication, opaque device/child identifiers, enrollment, entitlement/licensing, encrypted delivery, delivery state, timestamps and minimum operational/security metadata.

PAGE_NAME: Video scripts (rendered on Home and How PCA Works)
ENGLISH_SOURCE:
[1] Start by creating your PCA Parent account with your email address and a password.
[2] Open your inbox and confirm your email address to activate the account.
[3] Add your child inside PCA Parent. You only need enough detail to tell one child's protection from another's.
[4] Choose the platform your child's device uses. Android is the planned first platform for PCA Child, and iPhone and iPad child protection is planned for a later release.
[5] Create an invitation for that child. The invitation is what links a device to your family and to no one else's.
[6] When PCA Child is released, you will install it and open it on your child's device.
[7] Enter the setup code from the invitation, or open the setup link, so the child device and your parent account are matched to each other.
[8] Confirm the connection on the child device and allow the permissions PCA needs to apply your rules.
[9] Back in PCA Parent, choose the protections that fit this child: screen time, schedules, and app or web controls where the platform supports them.
[10] Finally, review the protection status, so you can see whether protection is working and what needs your attention.

PAGE_NAME: Video scripts (rendered on Home and How PCA Works)
ENGLISH_SOURCE:
[1] Children are protected everywhere they go — at home, at school, in the places where they play.
[2] The digital spaces where they spend time deserve that same everyday care.
[3] PCA began with a father's concern for his own children, and the belief that online life should not be the exception.
[4] So PCA is built to help with the everyday things where the child's platform supports them: screen time, safer browsing, app and web controls, and schedules that suit your family.
[5] It can tell you when something needs your attention, and it gives your child a clear way to ask for more time or access.
[6] PCA also takes a different approach to privacy: it is designed to protect your child without building a readable central profile of them.
[7] Routine protection does not require PCA to collect your child's photos, videos, files or messages.
[8] We believe a safer digital world should not depend on a family's income, so affordability and broad access are part of how PCA is designed.
[9] Start protecting your child's digital spaces. See how PCA works, step by step.

[3] بدأت PCA من اهتمام أبٍ بحماية أطفاله، ومن قناعة بأن حياتهم على الإنترنت ليست استثناءً.

[5] وتنبّهك عندما يحتاج أمر ما إلى انتباهك، وتمنح طفلك طريقة واضحة ليطلب وقتًا إضافيًا أو إذنًا بالوصول.
[6] ولـ PCA نهج مختلف في الخصوصية: صُممت لحماية طفلك دون إنشاء ملف مركزي مقروء عنه.
[7] فالحماية اليومية لا تتطلب من PCA جمع صور طفلك أو مقاطعه المصوّرة أو ملفاته أو رسائله.
[8] ونؤمن بأن عالمًا رقميًا أكثر أمانًا لا ينبغي أن يرتبط بدخل الأسرة، لذلك كانت التكلفة المعقولة وسعة الإتاحة جزءًا من تصميم PCA.
[9] ابدأ بحماية المساحات الرقمية لطفلك، وتعرّف على طريقة عمل PCA خطوة بخطوة.
